queries_run: Autoliv credit rating OR downgrade OR guidance cut 2026 customers

findings.claim: FY2025 前五大客戶約占合併淨銷售 44%、前十大約 70%；最大單一客戶合約約占 2%。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, our top five customers represented around 44% of our consolidated sales, and our largest customer contract accounted for around 2% of our consolidated sales.

findings.claim: 2025 年無單一客戶占淨銷售 10% 以上；前十大約 70%。
findings.excerpt: Sales to individual customers representing 10% or more of net sales were: In 2025: No individual customer representing 10% or more.

findings.claim: 中國本土 OEM 占 Autoliv 中國銷售比重由 2022 年 22% 升至 2025 年 44%；比亞迪成長 2025 年明顯放緩，且高度垂直整合，Autoliv 供應其子公司 FinDreams 零組件（主要為氣體產生器）。
findings.excerpt: In 2022, this group accounted for 22% of Autoliv's sales in China, and in 2025 their share of Autoliv sales in China was 44%.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋結果顯示 2026 年無 ALV 信用評等調降或指引下修（Moody's 2026-06 報告為 Baa1 穩定，僅見搜尋摘要，未逐字取得）；客戶端破產/降評未見來源。

clues.claim: Moody's 2026 年 6 月信用意見：Autoliv Baa1、展望穩定。
clues.source: Autoliv Investor Relations, Credit Opinion June 2026 (Moody's)
